# Renames applied on top of the generated mapping.
#
# The generated mapping turns each upstream identifier into ours by swapping the
# prefix. Occasionally that lands on a name the public interface needs for itself:
# the engine has its own lifecycle and extraction entry points, and the interface
# this project presents declares functions of the same names with different
# signatures. Two definitions of one name do not link.
#
# These entries move the engine's internal ones aside. Both sides keep the prefix,
# so nothing here names an upstream and this file needs no exemption from the scan.
#
# One entry per line: the name the generated mapping would produce, a tab, the name
# to use instead.

pdxe_init	pdxe_engine_init
pdxe_shutdown	pdxe_engine_shutdown
pdxe_extract_file	pdxe_engine_extract_file
pdxe_extract_file_ex	pdxe_engine_extract_file_ex
